name: Remote TV & movie metadata editor
summary: A freelance contract role researching, writing and checking TV and movie listings data for a Copenhagen-based metadata company. A Canada posting listed CAD 20/hour for a full-time allocation.
whatYouDo: You research titles, write and edit descriptions and details for movies and TV series, quality-check the data, and merge duplicate programme entries in Simply.TV's database, which TV and streaming platforms use. The work is remote, text-based and detail-focused. There have been English (Canada) and Canadian French versions of the role.
appeal: Remote, text-based, detail-oriented work with no phone duties
Canada postings (English and Canadian French) listed CAD 20.00/hour for a full-time allocation of up to 40 hours a week
A rare metadata and cataloguing role open to people located in Canada
The company describes itself as remote-first, with a team across 30+ countries
watchOuts: Freelance contractor: Simply.TV postings say there are no public holidays, sick leave, annual leave or pension, and you're responsible for your own taxes
It's unknown whether the English (Canada) data-editor posting is still open. A recent snapshot of Simply.TV's job board listed Canada only for a TV Station Coordinator role
Postings are copied across job aggregators with inconsistent dates and terms (freelance vs full-time)
One Simply.TV listing required a 30-minute online assessment before the first interview, and some prefer a relevant university degree
No independent worker reviews were found (Glassdoor results were for a different company)
Pay in other countries is much lower (e.g. €350–€600 a month), suggesting rates are set by location

credentials: Relevant university degree preferred in some postings; equivalent experience considered

compensation.notes: Simply.TV Canada postings (English CAN on Workable and Built In; Canadian French on Built In and Remotive): CAD 20.00/hour on a full-time allocation basis, up to 40 h/week, contractor set-up. Seen through search summaries; postings not opened. Contractor pay carries no benefits.

reliability.notes: Postings describe a full-time allocation (up to 40 h/week) rather than task-by-task work. Actual hours, contract length and whether a Canada role is open now were not verified, and no worker reports were found.

applicationSteps: Check Simply.TV's Workable job board for a current Canada posting (English or Canadian French data editor)
Apply with an English CV (postings say only English CVs are accepted)
Complete any online assessment and interviews
Set yourself up as a self-employed contractor for tax purposes
fitsIf: You're detail-oriented, like film and TV, and want remote, full-time-hours text work without phone calls.
notFitIf: You need employee benefits or more than about $20/hour before taxes.
